notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only the non-region unnamed Register Object Instance path, its generated private identity/name state, and induced discovery/known-instance lookup in Umbra's non-installable development profile. It uses only requirement candidates exported by the Requirements Lab and does not infer missing IDs. A separate contract covers the limited no-time deletion/removal slice that consumes registration ownership state. This contract intentionally excludes named registration and reservation, object update/reflection, timestamped/retraction or local deletion, DDM scope, ownership transfer, FOM sharing policy, save/restore, complete resignation disposition, remote transport, packaging, and all evidence promotion. The linked tests demonstrate a bounded implementation slice, not full IEEE 1516.1-2025 conformance.
